ONE ISSUE, ONE VERDICT.

If you found several independent problems, please open one issue each, or say so
below and we will split it at triage. Nothing gets dropped in a split: every part
keeps its own thread, its own reproduction, and your credit on each.

This is not a request for less detail. It is about how issues close. A report
with four findings closes only when the last one is settled, so three finished
fixes sit behind one unfinished conversation. Split into four, three close fast
and the fourth is visibly the only thing left.
-->
